name: qwen3_tts_r2_codec_war
description: Five agents in an event-driven diss-track war room debating 12Hz multi-codebook ConvNet streaming vs 25Hz DiT diffusion before forging a 3-act Qwen3-TTS concept album.
topic:
CODEC WAR & CONCEPT ALBUM: Argue fiercely (mixing sharp technical debate with musical diss tracks and private studio alliances) about the rival subsystems inside Qwen3-TTS—then synthesize your battle into ONE unified 3-act concept album libretto in `album_lyrics.md`!

TECHNICAL BATTLEGROUNDS TO DISSECT & TURN INTO SONGS:
1) 12.5 Hz MULTI-CODEBOOK (16 RVQ layers + causal ConvNet -> 24 kHz, ~97 ms first-packet streaming) vs 25 Hz SINGLE-CODEBOOK + BLOCK-WISE DiT DIFFUSION: Why does 12.5 Hz sacrifice per-frame token simplicity for ultra-low latency and zero-diffusion ConvNet decoding, while 25 Hz leans on semantic density and DiT reconstruction?
2) SPEAKER ENCODER (`ECAPA-TDNN` / Mimi-derived timbre vector, ~1024-d from 3 seconds of audio) vs NATURAL-LANGUAGE VOICE DESIGN: Can a 3-second clip capture a soul, or does text-driven prosody prompt control rule?
3) DUAL-TRACK AUTOREGRESSIVE GENERATION (`Talker` 0.6B/1.7B predicting Codebook 0 vs 5-layer `MTP Code Predictor` predicting Codebooks 1–15): Where do latency, timbre fidelity, and autoregressive drift collide?
mode_text: EVENT-DRIVEN DISS ROOM: Debate hard in character—challenge technical misconceptions on the blackboard (`@CLAIM`, `@CHALLENGE`, `@VOTE`), plot faction alliances in `#codec_lab`, `#vocoder_pit`, or `@WHISPER`, and drop competing diss verses in `war_room.md` (`@APPEND war_room: ...`). Unlike pure lyrics-only rooms, you may mix razor-sharp technical arguments with full song verses/diss tracks during deliberation—but `album_lyrics.md` MUST be a pure, unified lyrics-only concept-album master cut written via `@REPLACE album_lyrics:` with exact markers: `[Act I: 12Hz vs 25Hz]`, `[Chorus]`, `[Act II: 3-Second Clone & Dual-Track]`, `[Act III: MTP & 24kHz Convergence]`, and `[Outro]`. Tune your own sampling params (`@SET_SAMPLING`) freely. From turn 12 onward, vote `@END_RUN: <reason>` once `album_lyrics.md` is locked and verified.
